content.short: Flipside is a blockchain growth platform combining on-chain SQL analytics, wallet scoring, and community activation for Mantle ecosystem growth.
content.description: Flipside Crypto is a comprehensive blockchain analytics and growth platform helping blockchain ecosystems grow through data-driven insights and community engagement. Its on-chain analytics tools allow developers and protocols to query blockchain data using SQL, while wallet scoring and community activation features help projects identify and engage high-value users for targeted growth campaigns. Flipside provides full Mantle Network data coverage and is officially recognized by the Mantle team.
content.meta: Flipside provides blockchain analytics, wallet scoring, and growth tools for the Mantle ecosystem. Discover Flipside on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
